scene sky

And so the time has come again to watch girls take their clothes off — just in the acceptable sort of way that you can only get in trouble for if you’re caught staring for longer than two seconds at a time.

It’s fine in small doses, I think. Like Xanax or ice cream or anything else that helps you feel a certain way when the way you’re currently feeling has been labeled “wrong” by a team of psychologists.
What do they know, though? They haven’t seen the world I’ve seen.
And you haven’t either. Because chances are, you think I’m someone I’m not. Which you might actually be right about in a weird, roundabout way. I have a hard time keeping track of that too.
Either way, the point is, my world is different from this one. But my world is always changing and your world stays the same.
It stays painfully the same. Its bones can break and bend and its roots can sprawl out well beyond the confines of its forced perimeter, but it’s still Kumon-mi.
And you’re still a disembodied set of ears and eyes while I am but the voice. So together, we almost make a face!
A happy face — one that smiles from ear (yours) to ear (also yours) and neglects to ever remember how sad this story really is.
Because every second spent here is like a forced vacation away from where you really want to be.
My world. My house. Where you’re seated at the table for a fancy dinner with your significant other, prepared and plated by an angel of your creation.
Heaven isn’t real. At least not in the way you think. But if it was, I bet you imagine it’d be something like that.
And hey! Maybe you’re right, maybe you’re wrong. One of us would need to die to find out and it sure as heck ain’t gonna be me!
Please don’t let it be you either, though.
Please?
Anyway! Sorry for keeping you. Just wanted to drop in before everything goes to Hell. (Which is real, by the way. But again, not in the way you think.)
Maybe I’ll see you soon, I wonder?
I hope I see you soon.
scene onabus1
Anyway! Bus!
: Before I begin, I would like to say thank you to Molly for letting an unpleasant, three-legged centipede like me be the new dragon master.
: Dungeon master. And it’s really no-
scene onabus2
: Adventure start! Where are you?
scene onabus3
: You don’t know?!
: I believe we are on a bus.
: Ding ding! Tsuneyo gets a point!
: Of what?!
: Damage against the boss you’re fighting.
: How does identifying where we are currently located damage the boss?! Who is the boss?! And are we actually on a bus or is this just a parody of something significantly funnier?!
: Just let Yasu do things her way, Molly. I’m sure that at least one of our many questions will be answered by the end of this bus ride.
: I hope it never ends. I am finally winning at this game.
scene onabus4
: The real surprise here is that Molly didn’t immediately recognize this skit as a Dropout reference.
: Ding ding! Rin gets a point too! The boss is defeated!
scene onabus5
: Fuck yeah! Combat is so easy when I don’t have to roll!
: Why did the boss only have 2 HP?! And how did Rin also recognizing something manage to kill it?!
: She’s obviously just really good at this game. Duh.
scene onabus6
: Me? Absolutely not. I’m not really good at anything. Unless you count not being good at stuff. I’m really good at not being good at stuff.
: You’re really good at being cute too.
scene onabus7
: I’m confused. Are those two gay now? Because they seem gay now.
: Rin’s always been half-gay. Chika’s probably just worn down by the fact that everyone else likes Sensei and sees now as a good time to experiment.
: On the bus?...I feel like that’s illegal...
scene onabus8
: It is. Sexual content is prohibited and has resulted in Rin’s death.
: But we haven’t even done anything!
: I mean...
: Shh!
scene onabus9
: Rin, please roll to stay alive.
: Roll what? Which die? Or...dice? What am I rolling, exactly?
: The big one with the most numbers.
: Oh, fuck yeah. I never get to use my d100. The chances of me rolling a 5 are so much lower now!
: We all know you’re going to roll one anyway, so just get it out of the way now.
: Joke’s on you Futaba! That’s...a 25! My highest roll ever!
: That’s basically just a 5 on a d100, isn’t it? Because 20 divided by 5 is 4, same as 100 divided by 25. That’s essentially a 25%% roll if you convert those numbers to percentages.
: Did you really have to wait until right this moment to learn math, Ami?! What happens, Yasu?! Do I live?
scene onabus10
: Sorry, no. You needed to roll a 5 to live. Rolling a 25 has popped one of the tires on the bus. Now you must go on a quest to fix it.
: Where’s this bus even going, Yasuyasu? And how come there are a bunch of medieval adventurer thingies on it?
scene onabus11
: Sana — roll for initiative.
: Huh?...What?...Me? Why? Who am I fighting?
: Thaum. He is on the bus today too. He’s on the way to work.
scene onabus12
: Thaum doesn’t ride the bus to work! Buses don’t go to the Underdark! Nor do they even exist in our campaign! Do not desecrate my final boss in such a pitiful manner!
: I rolled a...oh! Natural 20.
: Thaum is dead!
scene onabus13
: No! He needs to die in a very specific way! He can’t be murdered on a bus he wasn’t even supposed to be on in the first place!
: What an inconvenient time to learn how dangerous public transportation can be. Especially for those who can not identify it.
: So is our campaign just over now? Thaum is the final boss, right?
: No, now you have to change the tire. Everyone roll! The highest roll inherits Thaum’s job at the supermarket.
scene onabus14
: Oh. Well I guess that’s that for that campaign then. I wonder what Molly will plan next?
: Today doesn’t count! It’s just a...dreamy...side story thing! I assumed Yasu would do better than this with the power I bestowed unto her!
: Why?
: Yeah. I think that one’s on you, Molly.
: Well, I think Yasuyasu did a great job! Come here, you!
: Ah! S-Stop! U-Uta! I’m...ticklish there!
: So is just everybody gay now or what?
: Pretty much...Everyone but you and Ayane at least...
scene onabus15
: Come to think of it, where is Ayane? Have you talked to her today?
: Me? No. I was too busy trying to oversleep so I wouldn’t have to come to the beach this year. Then you had to go and ruin everything, so thanks for that.
: Yeah, no problem. Do you think Sensei’s coming too?
scene onabus16
: Maybe. Why? Are you done guilting him into thinking he somehow managed to ruin your relationship? Do I get the room to myself again?
: That’s not it at all. I just-
: Ayane’s with Sensei right now. They’re coming together.
scene onabus17
: To...the beach I mean...
: But I wouldn’t be surprised if they were coming together in...other ways too.
: Thanks for that, lewd Sana.
: Yeah. We’re all so happy you’re like this now and definitely wouldn’t have thought of that on our own.
: I hope...he saves some for me...
scene onabus18
: Can you just shut up already?!
scene onabus19
: THANKS AGAIN FOR DRIVING, GEOFFREY! I REALLY APPRECIATE IT!
: Ayane, why are you screaming at your butler? He’s literally right there.
scene onabus20
: Oh, did I forget to tell you? Geoffrey’s hearing is all messed up right now after rescuing a bunch of orphans from a minefield. He nearly lost his arm when one went off right next to him!
: Am I...allowed to ask why a bunch of orphans found themselves in a minefield?
scene onabus21
: GEOFFREY! CAN YOU TELL SENSEI WHAT ALL THOSE ORPHANS WERE DOING IN A MINEFIELD?!
scene onabus22
: No luck. Guess you’ll just have to find out some other day.
: That’s fine. I’m still just glad he is a real person and not an imaginary friend you made up to cope with your dad forgetting about you.
scene onabus23
: Ha! As if! Who even needs a regular dad when you can just borrow your friend’s and have that one double as a lover?
: Maybe...don’t yell that in front of a guy who’s immune to land mines and has been effectively taking care of you for years?
scene onabus24
: It’s fine, Sensei. He can’t hear us. But even if he could, he already knows how I feel about you. I tell Geoffrey everything.
: Not...everything, I hope.
: Everything. But don’t worry, I leave out all of the most specific details. Those are for us and us only.
: And also sometimes Sana. Which I am now unfortunate enough to have to hear from her as well. This is my penance for being so excited about my endlessly overflowing love for you.
: So, you’re telling me this guy sitting in front of us is acutely aware that I am ejaculating inside of you on a regular basis?
scene onabus25
: Well, you don’t have to make it weird.
: You’re the one who made it weird by telling your butler. What if he told someone?
: He wouldn’t. Geoffrey’s sworn an oath of loyalty to me.
: And he’s so serious about it that he refuses to even leave the house without his dynamite vest that’s set to detonate the moment he ever lets me down.
: Wearing a dynamite vest, yeah.
scene onabus26
: It’s nothing to worry about, though. Geoffrey doesn’t have a problem with us either way because he knows how happy you make me.
: Yeah, I’m a bit more worried about the dynamite at the moment.
: If we die, at least we’ll die together.
: Not helping.
scene onabus27
: You know what will help, though?
: Another slumber party?
: Nope! I’m talking about another slumber-
scene onabus28
: Wait! Why do you know already? That was supposed to be a surprise!
: Probably because you always leverage the apocalypse to turn group outings into slumber parties to make sure you sleep in the same room as me.
scene onabus29
: Sleeping in the same room as you is just an added benefit. What I really love is friendship. And pajamas. So slumber parties are obviously the way to go.
scene onabus30
: Unfortunately, the main issue with that is that our pre-apocalypse slumber parties have pretty much all led to dead ends.
: And seeing as Makoto still refuses to weigh in on what we should do next, I’m more or less just trying to establish a routine where-
: Makoto has some ideas of her own.
scene onabus31
: Huh?
: They’re not really good ones, though. At least I don’t think so. But I’m surprised she hasn’t told you.
: Can...you tell me? Because I was pretty confident she just decided to blow me off after our secret lesbian meeting came to an end.
: Yeah, I- your what?
: Our secret meeting.
: Secret...what meeting?
scene onabus32
: You’ll just have to ask Miss Imai. She’s the one who found Makoto on top of me after all. My memory’s getting kind of hazy with all these resets.
: Ayane — did you become bisexual without asking me first?
scene onabus33
: Ugh...no. I wish. You’d like me so much more if I joined you in your escapades of conquering my entire friend group.
: Incorrect. There is nothing that can make me like you any more than I already do. But, getting back to the matter at hand-
scene onabus34
: Don’t get back to the matter at hand! I want to hear more about how much you like me!
scene onabus33
: Getting back to the matter at hand...Makoto’s ideas can be boiled down to two things at the moment.
scene onabus35
: The first is that routine is the opposite of what we should be going for right now. And that being less predictable might help us out of this mess if we’re...good enough at it.
: Well...that one’s not so bad, right? Because Maya was extremely predictable and she never got anywhere. It took you showing up to move things forward.
: And with Yumi now being a part of the team, things are kind of still moving forward.
: So maybe if we just...figure out how to maintain this pace, we’ll all eventually be aware of the loops?
: Maybe. And I’m fine with that if you are. I don’t see any need to rush when we have literally all of the time in the world. But there’s another thing. A more...interesting thing.
: I don’t really like the way you said “interesting” there.
: Makoto wants to get Maya involved again.
scene onabus36
: That’s all you have to add?
: Well, let me ask you this — how do you feel about getting Maya involved again? You’re the one who’s getting close to her all over. She’s mostly just mean to me.
: I...am not a fan of the risks involved. And, to be completely transparent, I’m not sure how I’d handle it if I were to break her again.
: But Makoto thinks her ability to sense when the resets are coming could be beneficial when it comes to...well, coordinating future slumber parties, for lack of a better term.
: Is...something wrong? Or are you just thinking?
: Nothing’s wrong, per se. Just...
: Hasn’t she seemed weird to you, lately? Specifically her and Ami. Together. As a unit.
: Uhh...well...I haven’t really seen Ami lately, so-
scene onabus37
: It’s...probably nothing. I just...have a hard time sort of...trusting either one of them right now. And I don’t want to accidentally ruin everything.
: You know full well how adamant our Maya was about keeping Ami out of this. And since we never really learned why, it’s hard to instruct this Maya to do the same.
: Which makes me think...if Ami has somehow gotten to her before us, and Ami is somehow a part of this-
: Ami’s not a part of this, Ayane. She never has been.
scene onabus38
: ...Yeah.
: Right.
: She’s just one more unfortunate victim of whatever is going on here.
: That said, maybe...talking to Maya on a more serious level might not be all that dangerous. Like...something as simple as just having her around for your latest slumber party.
: Sure...but when I’ve tried talking to her in the past-
: She’s more serious about learning now. This isn’t like how it was when she first got here and didn’t believe anything.
: Sure. But she’s only like that because she thinks it’ll help her get closer to you.
: Well...is that really such a bad thing? Tons of girls here base a bunch of their decisions on what it means for their relationship with me.
: Yeah, but none of them are Maya.
: Well, Maya isn’t Maya either. So that doesn’t-
: How many more times do you think you’ll be able to tell yourself that and still believe it?
: Sorry, I...
scene onabus39
: We can invite Maya to the slumber party...but under one condition.
: That...condition being?
: You give me just as much attention.
: Ayane-
: I’m serious, Sensei. And I will spare you the details, but it feels very bad watching you fawn over a doppelganger instead of your future wife. So all I ask is you pay just as much attention to me.
: Is that selfish? Yes. But that sort of thing is becoming necessary now — and this is me formally asking for a love allowance.
: A...love allowance.
: That’s right. For the infinite future, you will fulfill my weekly love quota.
: And in return — you will receive everything you have ever wanted and more.
scene black
: But something tells me that still won’t be enough...
Ayane rests her head on my shoulder and closes her eyes before I have a chance to respond, but I have no problem giving her what she wants.
But that’s only because she wants so little.
And what I want is exactly as she says.
It’s bigger than you. It’s bigger than me.
It’s bigger than everything.
And it’s because of this that I will remain forever unsatisfied.
